sloka: मयूरनादाभिरुतो गजराजनिषेवितः ।गम्यताम् भवता शैलश्चित्रकूटः स विश्रुतः ॥२-५४-४०॥
transliteration: mayūranādābhiruto gajarājaniṣevitaḥ ।gamyatām bhavatā śailaścitrakūṭaḥ sa viśrutaḥ ॥2-54-40॥

translations.english: O mighty Rama, I think mount Chitrakuta is the right place for you to stay. Go there. That mountain is full of trees of every kind, is inhabited by kinneras and uragas (serpents). It echoes with the cries of peacocks, is frequented by mighty tuskers. Filled with fruits and roots, it is sacred and pleasant.
